An early look, reposted from the organizers, at who will speak at the 2024 Global Audio Summit (GAS), China’s international audio industry conference, held on March 27–28, 2024, at the Zhangjiang Science Hall in Shanghai. (The headline borrows the title of YOLO, a Chinese box-office hit of that spring, to say the list is red-hot.)

The March 27 keynote session features Huawei, iFlytek, Sannuo Group and Edifier. Parallel sessions that day cover smart in-car audio (FAW, iFlytek, Huawei, Nanjing University, Sonavox, with XPeng and Arkamys to be confirmed), smart headphones and wearables (Huawei, Knowles, Edifier, Alango Technologies, Goertek, HiFiMAN and others), 3D audio (the UHD World Association, Huawei, Tencent Music, Dirac and others), electroacoustic components and chips (AAC Technologies, Actions Technology, xMEMS and others), and hearing aids (the China Audio Industry Association and major hospitals in Beijing and Shanghai). The evening ends with an informal fireside chat.

The March 28 keynote session brings in the Institute of Acoustics of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, the SparkLink Alliance, the Bluetooth SIG and Harman International. Further sessions cover in-car audio from carmakers including NIO, Li Auto, Zeekr and Great Wall, smart homes and conferencing, two more hearing-aid sessions, and sound and music technology with Fudan University, Northwestern Polytechnical University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen and the Communication University of China. More names were to follow.

Reposted on Ziyu Acoustics from an announcement by the GAS 2024 organizers.
